profiles.P0_scope: Any profile selected for P0 must be registered with its own source-derived input, delivery, per-account order, and market-key targets before the 1800-second run. The current code does not make N1-N6 P0-eligible.

configured_limits_from_accepted_c5_runne.source: The accepted c5 runner's fixed config builders and constants; values describe configured bounds, not observed high-water usage.

goodput.targets_are_derived_from: The selected accepted profile's source-defined per-topic input, logical delivery, and per-account order targets.
must_measure: delivered messages by strategy and topic

latency.outcome_classification: The future runner caller must classify each observed response or exception as success, error, or timeout; the collector validates the supplied category and does not infer it.

operation_coverage_by_profile.N5_N6: Not applicable until a source-accepted profile is registered and wired.

latency.aggregation: Report counts and nearest-rank latency for each strategy and operation; evaluate every required strategy-operation stratum against these targets. Operation-presence coverage requires each registered operation to be observed at least once per strategy, while workload-volume completeness is checked against the registered profile target counts. Also report total counts by operation. Do not pool per-strategy bounded samples as if they were one uniform population.
latency.sampling: A deterministic bounded reservoir may estimate percentiles; report total observations, retained sample count, capacity, coverage fraction, and whether the full population was retained. Never label sampled estimates as a full-population distribution.

must_measure: published source sequence at the stop point
time to close the sequence gap after slow pause or reconnect
recovery.profile_scope: Measure separately for each registered full-run profile; the existing reconnect path alone does not establish per-strategy catch-up.

cpu.hard_stop: Preserve the existing stop after 12 consecutive five-second samples above 95 percent.
cpu.summary_source: Actual resource samples only; report observed and expected sample counts, coverage, mean, p95, min, and max.

report_configured_and_observed_limits_fo: transport socket HWM and message-size limits
normal_shutdown_required: all expected children acknowledge normal close and exit zero
no unresolved registration, provider key, or uncertain unregister remains

scope_and_evidence_limits.dim07_reference: The accepted DIM07 coverage is separate evidence. LOAD01 should integrate its accepted CTP_QUERY hot-wave policy for N6 if/when N6 is registered, without repeating DIM07 account/API-key/IP/429/cancel-reservation/login evidence as new LOAD01 prerequisites.
scope_and_evidence_limits.N6_integration_boundary: The current N6 helper exercises synthetic shared-domain CTP_QUERY admission and deadline outcomes, not sustained concurrent workload/provider 429 behavior. A future LOAD01 N6 profile must show the admission wave during the registered workload and keep expected admission deadline outcomes separate from ordinary RPC timeouts.

measurement_gaps_before_wiring: No accepted runner collector reports per-operation submit/query/cancel latency percentiles or outcome counts.
No accepted full-run report summarizes CPU mean and p95 from all expected five-second samples.
Current full mode records published/consumed local counts but does not prove each strategy caught up to the exact final source-sequence watermark within the recovery target.
N6 is an accepted helper/unit round, not a sustained LOAD01 profile; N5 is uncommitted and excluded.
The current accepted runner records normal order lifecycle latency separately; preserve that metric and do not relabel it as any individual RPC latency.
